title: fix(plugin-detail,app-shell): a record page draws one provenance footer for its record (objectui#12307)
body:
Fixes #12307

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

## What changed

A record page now draws one provenance footer (`RecordMetaFooter`, the "Created … Updated …" line) for its record, however many `record:details` nodes it has. Triage comment `6140111288` chose this design: the host owns the footer, and no prop or spec key is added.

- **`@object-ui/plugin-detail`.** A `record:details` node that reads the record page's record (no `dataSource` binding) tells the one `DetailView` it mounts that the page draws the footer, and that `DetailView` then draws none. A node whose sections are all hidden now draws nothing. The signal is `RecordPageProvenanceContext`, a module-internal context in its own file (`recordPageProvenance.ts`). The package barrel does not export it, and it is not a `DetailView` prop or a `DetailViewSchema` key.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`.** `RecordDetailView` draws the record's `RecordMetaFooter` once, at the page foot. The Studio `PagePreview` draws it the same way under its sample record, in preview mode.
- **Kept:** a standalone `DetailView` (the `detail-view` node, `RecordDetailDrawer`, `RecordDetailPanel`, a direct React caller) keeps its footer. A **bound** `record:details` keeps its footer too, because it shows the first row of its own query, which is a different record from the page's.
- Docs: plugin-detail `README.md` gets a short section on who draws the footer. Changeset: `minor` for both packages, with a behaviour note.

Nothing is added to either package entry: no export, prop, type member or schema key.

## The dispatch's mechanism hypotheses, measured

1. **Mount site, and the host.** `DetailView` did mount `RecordMetaFooter` with no condition (confirmed). Two pieces render the page. The page host is app-shell `RecordDetailView`: it mounts `RecordContextProvider` and renders the page through `SchemaRenderer`, the `record` page renderer, and its regions. The `record:details` renderer (`RecordDetailsRenderer` in plugin-detail) is where each `DetailView` sits. The host draws the footer. The renderer tells its `DetailView` not to draw one.
2. **How a hosted `DetailView` learns it is hosted.** No existing context says "the page draws the footer". `RecordContext` is the existing context the record page already provides. Together with the node's binding predicate (`isElementDataSourceConfig`, which the binding gate and `isBound` in `recordBinding` also read), it tells the renderer whether the node reads the page's record. The plugin-detail README already states that contract: on a `type: 'record'` page, an unbound record block shows the page's record. The step from renderer to `DetailView` uses the module-internal context. No new published prop or export was needed, so the `Clause-②` re-judge does not apply.
3. **"An all-hidden node draws nothing."** This holds once the footer is gone. What remains of such a node is empty wrapper `div`s: no text, no border, shadow or card. It is pinned at both levels below. Residual: the empty wrapper still takes one slot in the region's `space-y-4` (a margin, not a drawn block). See Acceptance notes.
4. **Where the one footer sits.** At the page foot, after the page tree and after the panels `RecordDetailView` already appends there (the approvals fallback, permission-set assignments, the attachments fallback), and before the save bar. That is how this host already places page-level additions. Consequence: on the synthesized default page the line moves from inside the Details tab (above the discussion feed) to the foot (below it), and it shows on every tab.
5. **A `record:details` for a different record.** This shape exists: the per-element `dataSource` binding on record blocks. A bound node on a record page shows another record and keeps its own footer. This is pinned, not changed.

## Tests (at `0b74a1a`)

New pins:

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-details.pageProvenance-12307.test.tsx`: two unbound nodes under one record context draw no footer; an all-hidden node draws nothing; a standalone `DetailView` keeps its footer; a bound node on a record page keeps its own footer.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.oneProvenanceFooter-12307.test.tsx`: mounts `RecordDetailView` on an assigned record page with three `record:details` nodes (top line, body, all-hidden). It finds one footer, held by no node. The all-hidden node has empty text and no footer. The synthesized default page has exactly one footer.

Suite, declared narrowing (the full app-shell farm is CI's). Run from the repo root under the verify lock, at `0b74a1a`: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-detail/` plus the 155 app-shell test files that name `RecordDetailView`, `PagePreview`, `record:details` or `RecordMetaFooter` (selected with `git grep -l`), plus four console files that render record blocks or record pages (`record-block-record-reach`, `public-block-binding-reach`, and the `approvalRequestsDataSource` record-page and decision-page suites). Result: `Test Files 425 passed | 1 skipped (426)`, `Tests 3973 passed | 14 skipped (3987)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The existing footer pins (`DetailView.title2688`, `detailPage.emptinessAuthority-8394`, `detailTimestamps.displayLocale-9786`) render `RecordMetaFooter` directly and stayed green unchanged.

Reverse verification. Each run used `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit, blob hash proven, then restore proven: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty). The source is aliased in tests, so no `dist` was involved.

- **A**: in `record-details.tsx`, the provider value `readsPageRecord` was replaced with `false`. Result: 6 failed, 1 passed. Both "draw none" pins went red (2 and 4 footers). Both all-hidden pins went red: the text read `Created284d agoUpdated252d ago`, which is the footer-only block. The default-page pin went red with 2 footers. The bound pin went red on its page node. The standalone pin stayed green, as expected.
- **B**: in `RecordDetailView`, the host footer's `data` was replaced with `null`. Result: 2 failed, 1 passed. The several-nodes pin and the default-page pin each found 0 footers. The all-hidden pin stayed green, as expected, because it measures the node and not the host.

## Gates (at `0b74a1a`)

- Closure build: `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`. That closure includes plugin-detail and its dependencies. Result: `Tasks: 28 successful, 28 total`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check`: script echoed (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: same, exit 0. Both test tsconfigs include `src/**/*.test.tsx`, so the new pins are type-checked.
- The CI `Type Check` job's pre-tsc battery, in its step order, each exit 0: `check-type-check-coverage`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:published-tsconfig-exclude`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `type-check:scripts`, `type-check:vitest-config`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0 (7 source files of 2 released packages, 1 changeset). `pnpm check:control-bytes`: exit 0. `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`, exit 0. No `t(...)` call or pack changed, so the i18n gates ran only as part of the battery above.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 9 changed paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- ESLint, declared narrowing (repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's): `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 7 changed lintable files. The population is the root `eslint.config.js`, and none of the 7 is ignored. Counts from the JSON: 7 files, 0 errors, 217 warnings. On the 4 edited source files, warning counts are equal at the base (`068a540`, linted from `git show`) and at HEAD. The new module has 0. The 14 test-file warnings are `no-explicit-any` on `as any` fixtures, the same pattern as the sibling suites. Invariance: the config enables no type-aware linting, and no rule in `eslint-rules/` reads another file, so this diff cannot move the verdict of any untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- **Placement change on every default record page.** The footer moves from the Details tab to the page foot, below the discussion feed, and is visible on every tab. This follows the host's existing pattern for page-level additions. If the maintainers prefer "after the last `record:details` node", the block renderers would need a page-scoped registry, and the host would have to provide it through a published context. That is a different shape, not done here.
- **Behaviour change for other hosts.** Any host that mounts `RecordContextProvider` itself and renders `record:details` in it no longer gets per-node footers. It draws `RecordMetaFooter` once (already exported). The changeset and the README say so. In this repo, the only such hosts are `RecordDetailView` and `PagePreview`, both updated, plus the bound-record scope, which keeps its footer.
- **Studio design canvas.** In design mode, the block canvas renders blocks one by one and now shows no footer. Page chrome such as the save bar and the fallback panels is not drawn there either. Preview mode shows the one footer.
- **Residual slot.** An all-hidden `record:details` still mounts empty wrapper `div`s that occupy one `space-y-4` slot in the region (a margin, nothing drawn). Making the node return nothing would mean computing section visibility before render. Not filed: it is polish, and nothing is drawn.
- **Files outside the claim's list:** `PagePreview.tsx` (the Studio's record-page host, which would otherwise show no footer at all), the new internal module `recordPageProvenance.ts` (moved out of `DetailView.tsx` so that file keeps exporting components only), and plugin-detail `README.md` (the docs-driven commandment in AGENTS.md).
